description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pothupitiya, Kalutara D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530019
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and property characteristics) in the Kalutara District. The content focuses on land ownership registration, title settlement, and property rights - all falling under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
